discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological actions, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology underlies drugs with very large clinical and societal impact. Habener, Mojsov and Drucker received the 2024 Lasker Award and other major prizes for this work, it has not yet been recognized by the Nobel committee, and recent prizes (miRNA in 2024, peripheral immune tolerance in 2025) leave metabolic physiology as a likely next area.
